technical_notes.transport: All Phase 5 servers use STDIO transport (npm packages)
technical_notes.package_management: npx with -y flag for automatic installation
technical_notes.environment_variables: All use ${VAR} substitution pattern from environment
technical_notes.consistency: Follows exact pattern from Phase 2/3/4 servers
technical_notes.documentation: Comprehensive capability lists based on official API documentation and research

integration_highlights.intercom: Comprehensive customer messaging platform - combines live chat, support tickets, and help center for unified customer engagement
integration_highlights.asana: Flexible work management platform - task tracking, portfolio management, goal setting (OKRs) for cross-functional teams
integration_highlights.trello: Visual kanban boards - simple, intuitive project tracking with cards, lists, and checklists for team collaboration
integration_highlights.quickbooks: Small business accounting automation - invoice generation, expense tracking, financial reporting for complete bookkeeping

customer_support_escalation.description: Multi-channel support with Intercom, Zendesk, and Slack
flow: Intercom: Customer starts live chat conversation
Intercom: AI agent provides initial response
Intercom: Escalate complex issue to support team
Zendesk: Create ticket for issue tracking
Slack: Notify support team channel
Twilio: Send SMS acknowledgment to customer
Intercom: Update conversation with ticket link
Zendesk: Resolve ticket after solution
Intercom: Close conversation with satisfaction survey

team_project_management.description: Cross-platform project management with Asana, Trello, and Slack
flow: Asana: Create project and break down into tasks
Trello: Create visual kanban board for team workflow
Asana: Assign tasks to team members with due dates
Slack: Notify team of new assignments
GitHub: Create feature branch for development tasks
Trello: Move cards through workflow (To Do → In Progress → Done)
Asana: Update task progress and add comments
GitHub: Link pull requests to Asana tasks
Slack: Celebrate project completion

financial_automation.description: End-to-end financial workflow with QuickBooks, Stripe, and Shopify
flow: Shopify: Customer places order
Stripe: Process payment and capture funds
QuickBooks: Create invoice record automatically
QuickBooks: Record payment and reconcile
Shopify: Update order status to fulfilled
QuickBooks: Create expense records for cost of goods
Twilio: Send payment confirmation SMS to customer
QuickBooks: Generate monthly profit & loss report
QuickBooks: Track cash flow and accounts receivable

marketing_campaign_execution.description: Campaign planning and execution across multiple platforms
flow: Asana: Create campaign project with tasks and timeline
Asana: Assign content creation, design, and copy tasks
HubSpot: Set up email automation sequence
Intercom: Create product tour for new feature
Asana: Track task completion and move to review
HubSpot: Launch email campaign to segmented lists
Intercom: Trigger in-app messaging for active users
Slack: Post campaign performance updates
Asana: Mark campaign complete and document learnings
